elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance.
elements.evidence: Section 31 requires TrueLink to maintain commercial general liability insurance.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must provide at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 31 specifies not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must provide at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: Section 31 specifies not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: Section 31 expressly requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.

elements.element: Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance must provide at least USD 2,000,000 in coverage.
elements.evidence: Section 31 specifies professional liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber/privacy liability insurance covering that processing.
elements.evidence: Section 31 requires cyber liability insurance covering TrueLink's processing of Client Content and other Client data; the obligation is imposed directly rather than being left contingent.

elements.element: Required cyber/privacy liability insurance must provide at least USD 5,000,000 in coverage.
elements.evidence: Section 31 specifies cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: Section 31 requires workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor must provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: Section 31 requires TrueLink to provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing the coverage upon request.

result.reason: The operative clause satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It is not minimal because it additionally requires all coverage to be maintained at TrueLink's own expense for one year after the Agreement ends, neither of which was necessary to reach either stated position. The added obligations do not negate the requested insurance protections or contradict the force-majeure provision.
